install.notes: The clone is an unpublished uv workspace (root pyproject.toml). The hardware backend imports labmcp and labmcp-julabo, which live in packages/labmcp and servers/chemistry/julabo-circulator; a hardware deployment must install those distributions (for example pip install -e packages/labmcp -e servers/chemistry/julabo-circulator) in addition to the card's root install. The gate never imports native.py or the upstream package.
